fee_notes: $35,500 for Full Shoppe; $10,500 for Express Shoppe or Hosted Express Shoppe; $5,500 for Ice Cream Truck; $71,000 for Co-Branded Shoppe (of which $35,500 paid to Cinnabon). Veterans pay $20,000 for Full Shoppe. During 2025, franchisees paid $0 to $12,500. Fee is non-refundable.
